g.text: why did the gateway lock out an account
Open network ports were found — this is the system's attack surface.
A burst of login failures was observed in a short window.
[AUTH-004] Burst of 14 failed logins in 40s on the gateway
• auth.log: 14 failed password attempts for root, 03:41:02-03:41:42
A network-exposed SSH service combined with a burst of failed logins — a
pattern consistent with a brute-force attempt.
[CORR-001] Gateway lockout correlates with an internal auth burst 90s later
• internal-host.log: sudo auth burst on 10.0.0.4 beginning 03:43:10
• same credential family used in both — consistent with a lateral-movement
pivot attempt, not two unrelated incidents
